{{Top|leg}}
A '''Permit of Entry''' was a document that all otherworlders were required to openly display while in the [[Aramand Cluster]]. A Permit could be obtained from any [[Aramandi]] customs [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] or [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] within the Cluster.
